metricNotes.recordedRuns: R0 is the baseline, R1-R5 are the five trajectory-driven optimization iterations, and R6 is an additional post-review hardening regression.
metricNotes.totalTokens: Sum of provider-reported totalTokens in completed teammate turn outcomes; it is a trajectory comparison signal, not billing usage.
metricNotes.turns: Count of durable Turn records; R6 includes three completed teammate turns and one cancelled lead terminal turn.
metricNotes.elapsedMs: Difference between the durable team createdAt and completedAt timestamps.
metricNotes.databaseSha256: Digest of the captured local SQLite bytes. In particular, the R6 digest was captured before later read/checkpoint opens; SQLite may rewrite raw bytes without changing the recorded logical state, so this is a retention identifier rather than a long-term reproducibility claim.
metricNotes.trajectorySha256: Digest of the exported trajectory bytes; the R6 view was hashed directly from stdout and its raw file was not retained.
metricNotes.rawEvidence: Local validation artifacts, not stable product paths or published fixtures.

rounds.observation: Lead reminders sent while owners were working queued a second turn for every owner; shell syntax in two message bodies was expanded away; message chunks obscured control events; the durable lead turn remained open after team completion.
rounds.result: Functional completion, but 3 redundant teammate turns and an unclosed durable lead turn.

rounds.observation: Control behavior was fixed, but projected event objects still duplicated large tool inputs and turn snapshots, making the smaller event set larger on export.
rounds.change: Forbid reminders to working owners and shell syntax in message bodies, require first-turn inbox reads, omit message chunks, classify nested ACP events, and settle active durable turns at terminal team state.
rounds.result: Minimum 4 turns; every member stopped with no current turn; no unknown ACP event types.

rounds.observation: The lead requested another latency handoff even though the completed task already contained full evidence, causing one redundant owner turn.
rounds.change: Project tools and outcomes into bounded evidence: preserve lifecycle, status, usage, timing, counts, and bounded final response while removing duplicate raw output and response arrays.
rounds.result: Trajectory export fell 61.6% versus R1; tool payload bytes fell 81.5% and outcome payload bytes 59.4%.

rounds.observation: With duplicate handoffs removed, the lead still issued repeated status and inbox commands while waiting because stable ACP cannot inject mailbox updates into an active turn.
rounds.change: Make the persisted task result the sole authoritative completion handoff; reserve messages for questions, blockers, and coordination.
rounds.result: Minimum 4 turns and only the 3 initial guidance messages.

rounds.observation: Two owners copied the literal TASK_ID placeholder from their prompt, incurred a failed claim, and then retried with the real assignment id.
rounds.change: Add a blocking wait command so the lead waits once for all tasks instead of implementing a sleep/status/inbox polling loop.
rounds.result: The lead used exactly one wait call and retained the minimum 4 turns.

rounds.observation: No placeholder claim failures remained; all sessions and durable turns reached terminal state.
rounds.change: Render the assigned task id directly into teammate and wake prompts; omit claim and complete examples when no assignment exists.
rounds.result: Exactly 3 claim calls, all with real ids; 0 placeholder claims; one wait call; minimum 4 turns; 7/7 tests.

rounds.trajectory: stdout export from the recorded database; raw file not retained
rounds.observation: All members stopped with currentTurnId null, worker ownership files were empty, and the lead terminal turn was explicitly recorded as cancelled rather than completed.
rounds.change: Final regression for post-review hardening: atomic guided spawn, transactional team turn cap, explicit cancellation, supervisor shutdown and fiber settlement, and private state permissions.
rounds.result: Clean final hardening regression: 3 completed teammate turns plus 1 cancelled lead terminal turn; 7/7 tests; state mode 0600 and worker/session directory modes 0700.
